testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/shopping-cart/verify-amount-off-product-promotion-functionality.spec.ts > Webstore - Shopping Cart > verify amount off product promotion functionality

scenario.summary: A guest checks that an automatic Amount Off Product promotion is not applied to another product even at the raised quantity, gives no discount on the eligible product at quantity 1, and applies once the eligible line reaches the promotion's minimum quantity: discount = amount x quantity, order total = subtotal - discount. No order is placed.
steps: Guest (empty storage state): empty the cart, add the other product (sku3) at quantity 1, raise its line (name3) to the promotion's minimum quantity (updatedQuantity), reload
Check the discount is below amount x quantity (the product promotion is not applied); empty the cart
Add the eligible product (sku1) at quantity 1, open the cart, check there is no discount
Raise the eligible line (name1) to updatedQuantity, reload; check the quantity and the 'Discount (On Sub Total)' label
Read subtotal, discount, order total: discount = discountAmount x quantity; order total = subtotal - discount
Empty the cart and check the empty-cart message
stateChanges: Guest cart: products added, quantities raised, emptied
The promotion is found, or created for the run through its collection (POST /Promotion/Create) and deleted at teardown; no order is placed
assertions: Other product at updatedQuantity: discount < discountAmount x quantity - 1
No discount with the eligible product at quantity 1
Eligible line quantity equals updatedQuantity; discount label 'Discount (On Sub Total)' visible
Discount close to discountAmount x quantity (precision 2)
Order total close to subtotal - discount (precision 2)
evidence: Title: 'verify amount off product promotion functionality'; spec note: AUTO amount-off-PRODUCT promotion ($ off per unit, no code), guest flow

Profile: recorded sku1 z-2200004 (Speedaire, volume-priced) and sku3 z-2100025 (Campbell, requiredAddOnCount 1) are active simple products; atstage has no automatic Amount Off Product promotion for guests (DATA GAP of the query), so the promotion key is find-or-create

Link: the promotion is for product (productId @product.productId): the query finds an existing automatic promotion of that product, else the collection creates one on that product only. otherProduct is a different record by the distinct rule, so the promotion does not cover it
Profile Anonymous, allProfiles false: the created promotion applies to guests only (the export's ensureNoDiscountForNonSelectedProfiles is hard-disabled, so no user is needed)

notDiscountedForProfile Anonymous on product and otherProduct: no other automatic product/category promotion of the store touches them for guests (no discount at quantity 1; the other product gets no product discount at the raised quantity). With it the find path normally returns no row and the run creates the promotion

Quantity: recorded updatedQuantity 40 and discountAmount 15.00 are role data of the promotion (outputs minimumQuantity, discountAmount); the created promotion's minimum quantity is quantityUsed. quantityUsed 5 instead of 40: guest cart (Anonymous order promotion PromoAmountOffOrder, $800 minimum) must stay below 800 with one line at the raised quantity -> maxPrice 160 (5 x 160 = 800); at 40 the cap would be $20, below or near the $15 per-unit discount. minMaxQuantity 5 so the cart accepts the raised quantity

Expected values derive from outputs: discount = promotion.discountAmount x promotion.minimumQuantity; the spec's quantity (updatedQuantity) is promotion.minimumQuantity; sku/name from product and otherProduct
Risk (unchecked by params): a product priced below discountAmount may get a capped per-unit discount; the price range is (0, 160)

strategy migrate (swap rule fails): the expected discount is computed from the data (discountAmount x updatedQuantity) and the JSON schema reads both as strings while the promotion outputs are numbers
